title: NPDev R9 Scale Proof Report
description: One rung of the R9 nightly model-scale ladder (ROADMAP.md card R9 / ledger SCALE-1): scripts/proofs/run-scale-proof.ps1 synthesizes an N-concept model, drives it through synthesize -> generate -> ddl -> build -> boot -> firstRequest -> latency -> memory, and writes one instance of this shape per rung to an out-of-repo report path. Every appended entry under scripts/policy/scale-proof-baseline.json's runs.<concepts>[] array is one of these (schemaVersion v1 entries predate the ddl/latency/memory phases and are kept as historical ratchet entries, never rewritten to match this schema retroactively).

ddl.description: CREATE TABLE count in the generated V1__npdev_schema_realization.sql (value/unit: count). Static -- read right after generate, independent of build/boot succeeding.

build.description: Assembled app's own `gradlew clean build -x test` time.

firstRequest.description: One authenticated GET against the synthesized panel's runtime metadata endpoint.

latency.description: Average elapsed ms (value/unit: ms) across repeat requests against the same panel endpoint, once firstRequest already proved it works.

memory.description: Peak JVM resident-set size in MB (value/unit: mb), sampled from the bootRun process tree's own OS process counters -- not actuator metrics, which the dev,trial boot profile does not expose by default.

value.description: The raw measurement for phases where durationMs alone isn't the natural unit (ddl: statement count; memory: MB; latency: average ms, same value as durationMs).
